hooks.text: A blue asteroid is currently fizzing like sodium in water.
How does a solid rock produce a massive cloud of space dust?
The source of the Geminid meteor shower contains almost no dust.

title: The Blue Asteroid That Acts Like a Comet
description: 3200 Phaethon is a bizarre rocky asteroid that fuels the Geminids by fizzing like sodium under extreme solar heat.

beats.text: A blue asteroid is currently fizzing like sodium in water.
beats.visual: artist concept of blue asteroid 3200 Phaethon nearing the Sun

beats.text: In October 1983, astronomers discovered asteroid 3200 Phaethon, the source of our Geminid meteor shower.
beats.visual: Geminid meteor shower over a dark mountain landscape, photograph

beats.text: Astronomers long believed this strange rock comet was simply shedding dust along its path.
beats.visual: artist concept of a dead comet shedding dust trail in space

beats.text: Its elongated orbit crosses the paths of Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars.
beats.visual: diagram of 3200 Phaethon eccentric orbit crossing inner planet orbits

beats.text: It plunges within 13 million miles of the Sun, where surface temperatures reach 1,400 degrees.
beats.visual: SOHO spacecraft coronagraph imaging of a comet or asteroid near the Sun

beats.text: In 2023, data from the SOHO spacecraft proved its glowing tail contains no dust at all.
beats.visual: close up of a bright tail forming on a rocky asteroid surface

beats.text: Under that intense solar furnace, the solid rock is actually outgassing bright sodium vapor.
beats.visual: artist concept of glowing sodium gas outgassing from a rocky surface

beats.text: Yet this sodium gas is completely insufficient to explain the massive Geminid debris stream.
beats.visual: Earth passing through a dense debris cloud of meteoroid particles

beats.text: The mystery of that debris cloud is what keeps scientists watching this scorching blue rock.
beats.visual: JAXA DESTINY+ spacecraft mission concept illustration

better_than_last: Resolved the dangling conjunction in beat 9 by turning it into a complete, grammatical sentence that echoes the hook's blue rock imagery.
